messages:
anna_sales: Heads-up — Sherpa renewal next week. They've signaled a 2x uplift intention but asking for a 35% discount on Dedicated commit. Need POC confirmation and security signoff. Details below.

devon_solutions: @anna_sales thanks. Are they asking for Dedicated or Hosted? Do we have current throughput metrics from the last POC?

anna_sales: Dedicated. POC ran on dedicated small pool, avg latency 60ms p95, 700k tokens/day. They want SLA 99.9 and burst to 2k rps for demo.

mike_se: We can support 2k rps with a scale plan but cost goes up. For pricing — current ratecard: `Hosted gen: $0.02/token, Dedicated base: $0.012/token (committed), Peak burst add-on: $1,200/slot` — they'll want a blended rate.

jess_prod: Security flagged SC-3 in their questionnaire — they require KMS integration + audit logs for data retention. That will push them to Private or Dedicated with KMS. @legal_bot any blocker on KMS addendum?

legal_bot: Need to confirm customer-managed KMS terms. We typically accept BYOK via a standard addendum; timeline ~2 weeks. No showstopper but add to SOW.

devon_solutions: For the POC handshake: we can extend the existing Dedicated pool for 14 days. Need SRE to open capacity and set canary routing. Who owns provisioning? @eng-infra?

sara_sre: I can carve a temporary 2-slot pool Monday AM. Will need customer IPs for allowlist and a short runbook: `ssh bastion -> run canary` — share when confirmed.

anna_sales: Deal desk: requesting 35% off list for a 12-month 2x commit. Also asking for pro-rated start and a 60-day out clause. @dealdesk can we get pre-approval for up to 20% and escalations path?

dealdesk: Pre-approval up to 20% w/ standard T&Cs. Anything >20% needs Revenue manager signoff. For 35% we need documented justification: strategic account, multi-year, referenceable, or logo swap. Provide ARR impact calc.

mike_se: Quick ARR calc: current commit $120k/yr, 2x -> $240k. 35% off reduces revenue to ~$156k -> effective uplift only $36k. Not great unless they go multi-year or sign a case study.

anna_sales: I'll push for a 24-month + customer reference. Also add the KMS addendum and POC run dates. Action items: 1) @devon_solutions confirm POC slot by EOD; 2) @sara_sre prep runbook; 3) @legal_bot draft KMS addendum; 4) @dealdesk queue approval with ARR calc.

devon_solutions: Confirmed, I can start provisioning tomorrow.

sara_sre: Runbook draft attached (link): https://share.internal/sherpa-poc-runbook :eyes:

anna_sales: Thanks team — I'll update Sherpa and loop in their procurement. :thumbsup:
